scope: Align the existing D467@29 and E500@29 Core Delivery Drafts with the accepted Header.Container physical-containment rule while preserving optional same-stem grouping, recursive Step placement, and separately placed references.

source_authorities.use: Keep the derived direct IS_CONTAINED_BY/CONTAINS view consistent with the physical container. No duplicate authored relation is added.
No conflict: this carrier-address rule concerns non-Atom Artifact Properties; Header.Container is an Atom Property.
A same-stem Directory Carrier remains grouping for the Atom represented by its Markdown Carrier; it does not create another Atom or owner.

The RMED previews cite the proposed Atom.Header.Container property only. They do not adopt this Draft's stale full-path serialization details; latest decision is Scope Unit IDs only, mapping key scope_unit or atom, with root Project ID exception pending.

changes: Add Atom.Header.Container as a passive Subject.
Header.Container identifies the logical parent by Scope Unit or Atom ID; the resolved folder is its physical location.
A formal CONTAINS/IS_CONTAINED_BY edge, Header.Container, and resolved Carrier placement identify the same parent; CA-D-264 reads back that same direct fact.
An ordinary graph reference alone does not establish containment, change Header.Container, or move the referenced Step.
Add Atom.Header.Container as a passive Subject.
For formal parent-child containment, require Header.Container, the CONTAINS/IS_CONTAINED_BY edge, and the resolved physical placement to agree, with CA-D-264 reading back the same fact.
Permit ordinary references to separately contained Steps without assigning or changing their Container.

alignment_findings: D467/E500 retain optional same-stem recursive grouping. Only ordinary references to separately contained objects can remain external. A Step with a formal parent-child containment edge must be placed under its declared parent's resolved folder.

For formal Workflow CONTAINS Step or Step IS_CONTAINED_BY Workflow/containing Step, all representations identify the same logical parent by ID; the parent folder is resolved from that identity and CA-D-264 reads back the same direct fact. Directory nesting alone cannot override or create disagreement.

No execution order is inferred from folders. The formal CONTAINS/IS_CONTAINED_BY edge, Header.Container ID, and resolved parent folder are one containment fact; directory nesting alone cannot override or contradict them.
The existing cascade scope remains limited to contained latest Step Revisions in the parent Carrier tree; separately contained referenced Steps and Actions remain outside that cascade.
D267 and D460 remain unchanged and compatible: the property is on an Atom, and a same-stem directory groups the Atom represented by its Markdown Carrier.

policy_boundary.broader_pending: The root Project Declaration ID exception remains pending outside these Delivery previews. Scope Unit references use IDs only and resolve the current parent folder from that ID. No path, id_name, filename rename, or ID allocation rule is specified here.
policy_boundary.versioning: Preview bodies retain pinned Draft version/timestamp as a content-only rebase. Root owns any next Draft version and UpdatedAt assignment.
